en.t: After he finished reciting, tears fell like rain.

units.source_text: 隐约闻知其事的人中，有的想道：“皇子果然是热恋宇治女公子的。

en.t: Among those who had vaguely heard about the matter, some thought, "The prince truly is deeply in love with the young lady of Uji.

units.source_text: 今日错过机会，不能相见，难怪他伤心啊！”

en.t: He missed his chance today and could not meet her; no wonder he is so heartbroken!"

units.source_text: 此行规模盛大，随从众多，故不便访问山庄也。

en.t: The procession was grand in scale and had many attendants, so it was inconvenient to visit the mountain villa.

units.source_text: 众人吟诵昨夜所作诗篇中的佳句，用和歌咏宇治秋色者亦甚多。

en.t: Everyone recited fine lines from the poems composed the night before, and many also used waka to sing of Uji's autumn scenery.

units.source_text: 但此种醉迷歌哭之时所作的诗歌，安得有佳作？

en.t: But how could poems composed in such a drunken, bewildered time of singing and weeping produce any fine works?

units.source_text: 此处略举一二，也陋不足观，其余均从略了。

en.t: A few are briefly mentioned here, but even these are crude and not worth seeing, so the rest have all been omitted.
